name: Lift.TameChart.exists_z_smul_eq_sum_tameGen
summary: By the frame theorem, divisibility by z in M is tested with crystalline forms; for such a form, q(β) = 0 makes Σ q_k μ∘s^k vanish on the crystalline periods, so μ(Σ q_k s^k x) is a combination of Galois differences s^k y − y of elements of the bicommutant, each divisible by z.

steps.claim: Γ' is normal (conjugates of elements of Γ' lie in Γ').

By the frame theorem (crystalline forms test divisibility in M; z_dvd_of_dvd_E_pow_mul), and as Σ q_k s^k x ∈ M (smul_mem_kisinAinf, using normality), it suffices that for every crystalline form μ (with l : L → B_cris and μ(1⊗t) = l(t), E) z divides μ(Σ q_k s^k x) in B^+:
steps.lean:
frame_theorem.1.2.2.2.elim fun u v ↦ v _ d.z_dvd_of_dvd_E_pow_mul _ (by
    simp [↓sum_mem, ↓smul_of_tower_mem, ↓smul_mem_kisinAinf (n _) hx.1]) fun μ ⟨hl, l, E⟩ ↦ by

steps.claim: Let Λ_g be the B_cris-linear extension of t ↦ j(g)⁻¹·l(g·t).
steps.lean: let Λ g := (DistribSMul.toLinearMap _ _ (toGp g)⁻¹ ∘ₗ l ∘ₗ overZp L.ρ g).liftBaseChange Bcris

have A g g' y : Λ g' (tensorAction _ (toGp g) (L.ρ g) y) = toGp g • Λ (g' * g) y := by
    clear * -; induction y <;> simp_all [Λ, tensorAction, mul_smul]
steps.typed_fact: Λ g' (tensorAction _ (toGp g) (L.ρ g) y) = toGp g • Λ (g' * g) y

steps.claim: Σ_k q_k·Λ_{s^k} = 0: both sides are B_cris-linear and L is potentially crystalline, so it suffices on the periods fixed near 1, where s^k acts through β^k (linearFrob_pow, the Weil pair) and Λ_{s^k} = Λ_1∘β^k; and q(β) = 0 (r).
steps.lean:
have S : ∑ k ∈ _, q.coeff k • Λ _ = 0 := ext_on L.inClass.isPotCrys fun y b ↦ by
    simpa [← linearFrob_pow L.inClass.isPotCrys d.isWeilPair_tameGen, fun k ↦ linearFrob_apply (m := 0) L.inClass.isPotCrys (d.isWeilPair_tameGen.pow k) b ▸
      (A _ 1 _).trans ((d.isWeilPair_tameGen.pow k).smul_eq_of_fixed_nearOne (.mp b (d.nearOne_le fun g b ↦ .trans (by
      rw [A]; congr 2 with _
      simpa [Λ, E, mul_smul, eq_inv_smul_iff, -map_pow] using (conjForm_mem_forms (n _) hl _ g).symm)
      (congrArg _ b)))), aeval_eq_sum_range] using congr(Λ 1 ($r y))

steps.claim: Hence μ(Σ_k q_k s^k x) = Σ_k q_k(μ_k(s^k x) − …) with μ_k = the conjugate forms (apply_eq_of_mem_fracSpan), a sum of Galois differences s^k y − y of elements of the bicommutant, each divisible by z in B^+ (z_dvd_sub, s^k fixes Λ; pow_smul_gal_sub_mem_span_of_dvd).
steps.lean:
simpa [smul_sub, smul_comm (q.coeff _), ← smul_sum, by
    simpa using apply_eq_of_mem_fracSpan (∑ k ∈ _, q.coeff k • conjForm μ (d.tameGen ^ k)) 0 (by ext; simpa [basisValues, Λ, E, smul]
                                   using congr(($S (1 ⊗ₜ _) : BdR))) (kisinAinf_le_fracSpan hx.1)] using! sum_mem (t := range
    q.natDegree.succ) fun k _ ↦ smul_of_tower_mem _ (q.coeff k) (pow_smul_gal_sub_mem_span_of_dvd (d.z_dvd_sub (d.fixesLambda_tameGen_pow k))
    (u _ ⟨conjForm_mem_forms (n (d.tameGen ^ k)) hl, (liftBaseChangeEquiv _).2 (Λ (d.tameGen ^ k)), by simp [Λ, E]⟩ _ hx))
